notes.title: THE DEMONIAC ​​TV RANKED TOURNAMENT HAS STARTED!
notes.content:
THE DEMONIAC ​​TV RANKED TOURNAMENT HAS STARTED!

Since Demoniac TV is in a near launch stage, I decided to do something special. I reset the entire leaderboard and now the 3 people on the podium (if they are on the Demoniac TV server) will receive a free game key. Ranked mode is limited to the content of the demo, so new bosses and enemies will not be present.

Good luck to everyone! 

Server link: https://discord.gg/Gc8AskjHAe
